anomalies: obsolete_strict == obsolete_loose == 44: every obsolete notice in this family is the strict line-start "Obsolete." form at line 12, so the B-A difference is 0 here and this family has none of the "Obsolete for documents created in ..." / "Obsolete and not superseded." variants.

9 pages are empty shells (frontmatter + H1 title only, no Signature/Parameters/Returns); all 9 are kind: property, and 18 property signatures + 9 shells = 27 which matches _overview.md property_count 27, and 315 methods + 27 properties = 342 = members_total (cross-check consistent).

13 zero-arg method pages have no "## Returns" section at all; 12 are void (expected) but GetCameraDefinition() returns Camera and the official page simply omits Returns - an official omission, not a parsing failure.

IGetAttachments and IGetMaterialPropertyValues carry the pointer literal inside "## Returns" AND elsewhere, so they are counted only under pointer_returns; pointer_returns(10) + pointer_params_only(8) = 18 counts over 17 distinct pages containing the literal.
IListExternalFileReferences repeats the literal 7 times and IGetSearchData 3 times - counting is per page, not per occurrence.
IPrintOut2 and IPrintOut3 are simultaneously obsolete and pointer-only; both take parameters so they do not affect zero_arg_methods.

NeedsRebuild is a property signature "System.bool NeedsRebuild {get;}" that also carries an "Obsolete." header - it is counted in properties_no_paren because criterion F states no non-obsolete filter.
GetMassProperties2 is obsolete with successor [[IMassProperty2]] (an interface, not a *2 method), a wording variant that still matches the strict "Obsolete." line-start form.
